skills.name: Values, branches and loops
skills.about: Arithmetic, if and else, for and while. Everything else stands on this.

skills.name: Strings
skills.about: Indexing, slicing and walking through text one character at a time.

skills.name: Lists, dictionaries and sets
skills.about: Counting with a dictionary and removing repeats with a set. Most interview problems start here.

skills.name: Files and classes
skills.about: Reading data from disk and bundling data with the functions that work on it.

skills.name: A language model by counting
skills.about: Count, normalise, sample, measure the loss. The same four steps every later model takes.

skills.name: Arrays and hashing
skills.about: Trade memory for time: remember what you have seen so that one pass is enough.

skills.name: Two pointers
skills.about: Two positions that move toward each other, or one that trails the other.

skills.name: Sliding window
skills.about: A stretch of the input that grows on one side and shrinks on the other.

skills.name: Stacks and queues
skills.about: Last in, first out, and first in, first out. The stack is also how recursion works underneath.

skills.name: Binary search
skills.about: Halve the range of possible answers at every step.

skills.name: Bit manipulation
skills.about: XOR, shifts and masks. Daily work in embedded code, and a small interview topic.

skills.name: Recursion and backtracking
skills.about: Solve a smaller copy of the same problem, then combine.

skills.name: Linked lists
skills.about: Nodes that point at the next node. Pointer work with nothing to index.

skills.name: Dynamic programming
skills.about: Recursion that remembers its answers.

skills.name: Trees
skills.about: A node and two smaller trees. Depth-first by recursion, level by level with a queue.

skills.name: Binary search trees
skills.about: A tree kept in order, so that one comparison at each node picks the side.

skills.name: Heaps
skills.about: Keep the k best of a stream without sorting all of it.

skills.name: Graphs
skills.about: Trees with loops in them. Breadth-first search, topological order, shortest paths, spanning trees.

skills.name: Sparse and structured matrices
skills.about: A matrix that is mostly zeros, or fixed by one row, should not be stored as n squared numbers.

skills.name: Arrays and linear algebra
skills.about: Vectors, matrices and the operations every model is made of. Stage 1.

skills.name: Data and metrics
skills.about: Splits, scaling, and the numbers you report: accuracy, precision, recall, F1. Stage 1.

skills.name: Regression and gradient descent
skills.about: A loss, its gradient, and the loop that follows it downhill. Stage 1.

skills.name: Neural nets from scratch
skills.about: Activations, backpropagation and an autograd engine. Stage 2.

skills.name: Classic ML for interviews
skills.about: k-means, trees, PCA, SVM, naive Bayes: the models interviewers ask you to write on a board.

skills.name: Deep learning layers
skills.about: Convolution, normalisation, dropout, recurrent cells and optimisers. Stage 3.

skills.name: Attention and transformers
skills.about: Self-attention, positional encoding, and the pieces of a GPT. Stage 4.

skills.name: Reinforcement learning
skills.about: Bandits, value functions, policy gradients. Stage 6.

skills.name: From logits to text
skills.about: Temperature, top-k and top-p, beam search, and the RMSNorm and RoPE blocks of 2026 models.

skills.name: Fast inference
skills.about: The KV cache and grouped-query attention, 8-bit weights, speculative decoding.

skills.name: Retrieval and RAG
skills.about: Chunking, dense and keyword retrieval, hybrid search, diverse results, and packing a context.

skills.name: Measuring retrieval and answers
skills.about: Recall@k, MRR, nDCG, exact match and token F1: the numbers behind 'is the RAG system any good?'.

skills.name: Fine-tuning and alignment
skills.about: The masked fine-tuning loss, LoRA, reward models and DPO.

skills.name: Agents and LLM apps in production
skills.about: Checking tool calls, the agent loop, rate limits, caching, cost and streaming.

skills.name: SQL: filter, group and join
skills.about: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING and the joins, on a small bank's tables. Asked in nearly every data interview.

skills.name: SQL: window functions and analytics
skills.about: Ranks, running totals, LAG, streaks and retention: the SQL that separates candidates.

skills.name: Probability for data science
skills.about: Bayes' rule with base rates, expected value and variance, the binomial tail.

skills.name: Intervals and tests
skills.about: Confidence intervals, p-values, the bootstrap and permutation tests, written from scratch.

skills.name: A/B testing
skills.about: Two-proportion tests, sample size and power, sample ratio mismatch, many metrics at once.

skills.name: Validation without leakage
skills.about: Folds, and every fitted step learned from training rows only. The most reliable ML interview topic.

skills.name: Scores, thresholds and calibration
skills.about: ROC-AUC from ranks, log loss and Brier, choosing a threshold by cost, weight of evidence for credit models.

skills.name: Speedup, schedules and caches
skills.about: How much faster a program can get, how a loop is shared among threads, and why the order of memory reads matters.

skills.name: GPU kernels, the CUDA way
skills.about: One function, run once in each of thousands of threads. Written in Python with CUDA's own names, so it carries over to CUDA C.

skills.name: MapReduce and message passing
skills.about: Work spread over machines that share no memory: map and reduce, combiners, and the tree behind MPI_Reduce.

skills.name: Roots, integrals and derivatives
skills.about: Answers from function values alone: where a function is zero, the area under it, its slope, and the curve through given points.

skills.name: Linear systems
skills.about: Solving A x = b by elimination and by iteration, and why pivoting is not optional.

skills.name: Markov chains and queues
skills.about: Where a random process settles: stationary distributions, a queue in steady state, PageRank, and the first singular vector.

skills.name: Complexity (Big-O)
skills.about: How running time and memory grow with the input. You state it for every interview answer.

skills.name: ROS 2
skills.about: Nodes, topics, services, actions, QoS. You know this already; the quiz keeps it sharp.

skills.name: MLOps and ML system design
skills.about: Validation that matches production, deployment patterns, monitoring and drift.

skills.name: Federated learning
skills.about: FedAvg, non-IID data, secure aggregation, differential privacy.

skills.name: Edge deployment
skills.about: Quantisation, pruning, distillation, and measuring latency on the device.

skills.name: RAG and agents
skills.about: Retrieval, tool calls, agent loops, and how to tell whether an agent did its job.

skills.name: Generative AI interview questions
skills.about: Decoding, serving, quantisation, alignment, RAG evaluation and agents, as asked in 2026.

skills.name: Experiments and A/B tests
skills.about: p-values, power, peeking, sample ratio mismatch, interference, CUPED, Simpson's paradox.
